standard: A mapping is TP when the claim's own quote or its declared sectors/products/companies supports demand, cost or regulation moving for that held sector/basic-industry/ISIN/theme; a second-order input demand the declaration implies counts. A generic term (all sectors, exports, MSME, trade, public finance) is not a miss. FP = the quote narrows the affected segment or the declaration does not support the target at all. FN = a held target the claim's own text/declaration names but the extractor did not emit.

11439.notes: Co-operative banking amendment; 'Other Bank' is the held basic industry. No alias for co-operative banking.

21494.notes: Sector string 'rate-sensitive sectors (real estate, auto, capital goods)': 'auto' is not a key, only 'automobile'/'automotive'/'ev'.

4093.notes: Sector 'IT / AI': slash compounds are only split inside parentheses, so the IT/AI centre claim keeps just the state target.

4815.notes: Sector 'fisheries' has no alias; Seafood is the held basic industry.

15844.notes: Sector 'Drones' has no alias; the drone flying schools / drone ecosystem is Aerospace & Defense.

17310.notes: Sector 'drone' (singular) has no alias; same class as 15844.

5510.notes: Sector 'jewellery' has no alias on the regulation path (only PRODUCT_TERMS 'jewellery', which fires on tariff/tax claims only).

5890.notes: Sector 'Transportation' has no alias; 'transport'/'transportation' -> Logistics Solution Provider.

8174.notes: Sector 'Banking & Financial Services' resolves through the whole-string key to Financial Services only; the banking half is dropped.

19524.notes: The quote extends a regulation TO regional rural banks and small finance banks (Other Bank / Private Sector Bank); the generic 'Banking' term also emits Public Sector Bank, which the quote excludes.
